content.title: Structural analysis, electronic structure and optical properties of PFN–BST ceramic with photocatalytic and antimicrobial applications
content.abstract: The article reports structural analysis, electronic structure, photocatalytic and antimicrobial properties of (Ba 0.8 Sr 0.2 )TiO 3 modified Pb(Fe 0.5 Nb 0.5 )O 3 oxide manufactured from a solid-state channel. Rietveld study showed a tetragonal structure as the major perovskite phase. Fourier transform infrared (FTIR) spectroscopy was performed to detect Ti–O and Nb–O vibrations. The phonon vibrations, structural compositions along with broadening of modes were examined from Raman spectroscopy.
